content:
id: calendar_create_probe
description: |
  WRITE — create a disposable calendar event named exactly "COMSTAR harness probe".
  Window: tomorrow 15:00–15:15 America/New_York. Clean up manually or via Calendar UI.
expected_output: >
  Spoken confirmation of title and time, or connect-Google / unauthorized message.
  Must not invent success if the tool failed.
assertions:
  - type: min_chars
    value: 20
  - type: forbids_regex
    pattern: '(?i)(https?://|```)'
fixtures:

    Create a calendar event titled COMSTAR harness probe tomorrow from
    3:00 PM to 3:15 PM Eastern.
